content.title: Cover Mission Payoff | Persistent Defense, Support Call and Visible Result
content.summary: An adult rescue captain holds a passage until one support call clears the exit. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject and one destination axis persist. + Threat count and proximity increase monotonically. + The visor warning agrees with visible positions. + Exactly one final decision gesture occurs. + The sequence stops before inventing victory or injury.
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult rescue captain holds one flooded transit passage and signals evacuees forward. She raises one radio and completes a single support call while the exit remains visible behind her. She drops to one knee from exhaustion as evacuees cross the cleared threshold behind her.
required_anchors: One clearly adult lead and one objective axis persist.
Interruptions leave visible continuity rather than resetting the scene.
The call precedes a visible external result.
The final state proves both objective completion and personal cost without graphic injury.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult rescue captain holds a passage until one support call clears the exit. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一成年指挥官在燃烧巷道维持防线，受压后仍完成一次无线电呼叫；远端打击成为可见结果，人物倒地作为代价收束，动作克制且无血腥特写。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult lead and one objective axis persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult lead and one objective axis persist."

invariants.rule: Interruptions leave visible continuity rather than resetting the scene.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Interruptions leave visible continuity rather than resetting the scene."

invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Exactly one support call occurs."

invariants.rule: The call precedes a visible external result.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The call precedes a visible external result."

invariants.rule: The final state proves both objective completion and personal cost without graphic injury.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final state proves both objective completion and personal cost without graphic injury."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
